recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast monochrome surrealist landscape featuring a musician seated on water next to a large floating sphere, set against a dark cosmic sky with airbrushed nebular script and a thin white border frame.
coreVisualRelationships: The large white sphere balances the seated figure on the horizontal plane.
The airbrushed script follows a diagonal upward trajectory from left to right.
The central glowing sun/moon acts as a vertical axis between the sky and the water's reflection.
The thin white border contains the entire composition, creating a window-like effect.
coreInvariants: Presence of a perfect geometric sphere
Airbrushed glow effect on the primary script

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The musician and sphere occupy the lower third; the sphere is roughly the same scale as the seated figure's torso.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright white sphere in the lower left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the sphere, moves right to the figure, then follows the diagonal script upward into the starfield.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black space in the upper half, punctuated by stars and clouds.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays (water ripples and cloud textures)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value contrast with no chromatic saturation; emphasis on tonal gradients.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a thick, airbrushed script with soft, blurred edges.
Secondary text uses a wide-tracked, ultra-thin geometric sans-serif.
The script features a 30-degree upward slant.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'W' in the script has a deep, rounded valley.
The 'O' in the sans-serif is a perfect circle.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, blurry script and rigid, geometric sans-serif.

preserve: Extreme wide tracking of the top text
The soft-glow effect of the script

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura Light or ITC Avant Garde
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, thin-stroke uppercase metadata text.
The main title requires a soft, non-vector appearance that standard fonts cannot replicate.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A monochrome surrealist landscape. A dark night sky with a central glowing sun behind symmetrical clouds and a starfield. Below, a calm water surface with ripples. On the left, a large, perfectly smooth white sphere floats just above the water. On the right, a man in 1970s attire sits cross-legged on a small rug on the water, playing an acoustic guitar. Surround the entire image with a thin white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, white, airbrushed cursive script across the center-sky, angled upwards. Add the artist name at the very top, inside the border, in a thin, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the sphere perfectly round and bright white?
Is the top text tracked out to span the width of the frame?
Does the script have a soft, glowing edge?

adjustableVariables: Scale of the sphere relative to the figure
Intensity of the airbrush glow on the script

avoid: Flat, solid black backgrounds without texture

postGenerationChecks: Check for thin white border integrity
Ensure the musician's reflection is visible in the water
Verify the script is legible despite the glow
Confirm the sphere is the brightest element in the lower half
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Surrealism + Geometric Primitive + Airbrushed Script + Wide-Tracked Sans-Serif + Thin Border Frame
